description: Riassunto rilievo traffico automatico anno is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Provincia Autonoma di Trento. Nel corso dell' anno 2014 si è svolto un censimento della circolazione stradale usando dei sensori automatici di rilevamento traffico posizionati in punti strategici della rete viaria provinciale. Coverage: Provincia Autonoma di Trento. The portal lists 11 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Provincia Autonoma di Trento. Its tags are mobilita, rumore, servizio-gestione-strade, strade, traffico. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
